content:

Or, je n’arrive pas a restaurer mon achat sur mon Mac.

author: realpurelife
title: The October 2017 update is good
content:
The app is now quite good thanks to the Oct. 2017 update: songs can be put in a play list, AirMedia works randomly, though. Cataloguing songs from a NAS works almost fine, and the interface is good enough but confusing. 

Now, with 15,000 from a NAS over Samba, Evermusic Pro fails to properly catalog many songs: the artist, album, etc. information is not read for all the songs, which makes searching difficult. This is the biggest bug I have encountered. 

I looked for and tried a few other similar apps (but only free ones) and they were definitely inferior. 

Recommended but with the big caveats above about AirMedia, the incomplete cataloging, and the relatively confusing interface.
